# <a id="_Toc171863106"></a>Objective And Scope

The objective of this document is to outline a strategy to switch Cloud Services, if a need arises\. The scope of the document is to identify and enumerate elements of current service offerings that will need deliberate consideration, categorize them, and outline strategies to handle the switching\. Detailed processes and procedures to accomplish the switch are out of scope of this document\.

# <a id="_Toc171863107"></a>Key Elements of Teamcenter X Service Offering

## Explicit flexibility

The TcX pipeline is developed to be flexible; the same pipeline outputs deployments to two major cloud platforms \(AWS and Azure\)\.

## Migration of customer data

Customer data is found in Bulk File Shares or RDBMS\. These are all within scope of the respective backup procedures\. In extreme cases, a backup can be created, saved to a secure non\-cloud location, then used to enable a customer in a different cloud provider\.

All other data is ephemeral and can be \(re\)deployed via the pipeline if required\.

#### Specific DB used by Integrations\.

Each integration is responsible for its own backup and restore procedures, as well as its own cloud switch strategy\.

## Runtime Environment

### Infrastructure Services Provided Siemens Xcelerator Foundation team

Several Runtime Infrastructure Services consumed by Teamcenter X like container runtime, cloud account security, secret management, logging, monitoring, etc\. are managed by Siemens Xcelerator Foundation team\. FT FDS is responsible for the cloud switching strategy\.

### Integrations

Integrations are responsible for defining their runtime environment cloud\-switching strategy\. 

### Tenant Specific Configuration or Customizations	

Tenant specific configurations and customizations are configuration managed in tenant specific GitLab repositories\. These repositories are hosted in Siemens environments and are cloud vendor independent\.

### Siemens Xcelerator Runtime Services

Teamcenter X also relies on Siemens Xcelerator Platform for services like SAM, SAMAuth, ARM, Admin Console, Entitlement, Software Center, etc\. Teamcenter X will follow strategy, process and procedures outlined when outlined by Siemens Xcelerator Services\.

### Siemen Business Stack Integrations \(BizTech\)

The BizTech team will need to evaluate and provide requirements, if any, for Teamcenter X\.

# <a id="_Toc171863108"></a>Conclusion

Teamcenter X is designed to be flexible with respect to target cloud environment\. Core functionality of TcX does not depend on specific functionality from cloud vendors\. We have strong dependencies on the Siemens XCelerator infrastructure and runtime services\. Teamcenter X integrations are responsible for their own cloud switching strategy\.
